title: PTI Stages Nationwide 'Black Day' Protests on 3rd Anniversary of Khan's Detention
detail: Thousands of PTI supporters held demonstrations across Pakistan to mark three years since Imran Khan's August 2023 arrest and demand his release, with major rallies outside Lahore's Aiwan-e-Adl led by the Insaf Lawyers Forum and near the Karachi Press Club, where blocked roads disrupted traffic. Khan, now 73, is serving a 14-year corruption sentence and a 17-year sentence over state-gift mishandling; Amnesty International and UN mechanisms have criticized his detention conditions, alleging solitary confinement and restricted family/legal access, which the government disputes. Solidarity protests were also held by overseas PTI chapters, including in Detroit.

media.caption: PTI supporters protest in Pakistan marking three years since Imran Khan's imprisonment
